# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Look up the testing frequency. (Weekly, biweekly, or per chlorinator campaign)
3. Are any inspections expired? If so, notify the vendor and update inspection records. (When vendor conducts inspection, upload to Dashboard)
4. If none are expired, look for any past-due tests missing, and enter defaults in SDWA-T controller.
5. Find samples collected at those past-due inspections, and:
   a. Search for any tests that did not come back within three business days or did not come back within the required frequency interval. Identify these as failed tests.
   b. If sample came back with failed test, log that sample missing and vendor with alerts in SDWA-T controller. Also document in spreadsheet.
